note: Explained differences between a lecture and the Cengel 9e book. check_book.py labels these instead of raising them. Key: <course>-lecture-N, then fit:<solve block> or table:<value>.

mech330-lecture-2.fit:P1: AU slides 4 to 6 use the 8e SI version of Example 10-4 (15 MPa, 600 °C, 10 kPa, x6 = 0.896, P_reheat = 4 MPa, eta = 0.450); the 9e prints Example 10-4 in English units and quotes 45.0 % on p. 567. Logged in assistant/cengel-study/corrections.md.
